name: Burger Boss
summary:
#Your Hands. Your Kitchen. Your Burger! 🍔

**Ever dreamed of running your own burger kitchen? Burger Boss brings the fun of cooking right to your table with an exciting mixed reality experience! Prepare juicy burgers, crispy fries, and delicious sides using just your hands. No controllers needed!**
